scope_expansion: package.json -- adds the named test:integration:vnext-mutation-gating command requested by the story validation plan.
stories.team_investigation: Engineering: added a projection-to-ProductSet adapter and a narrow ShopifyConnector.applyControlledMutation method that accepts prebuilt ProductSet input, reuses ShopifyApiClient.graphqlRequest, requireCredential, access-token resolution, token-expiry handling, and parseShopifyUserError/ShopifyPublishError, and deliberately does not call legacy buildProductSetInput, updateDefaultVariantPrice, connectorFramework.publish/update, or publishablePublish. Required-agent review (Einstein) flagged the provider-neutral projection boundary, release/allowlist exactness, real credential context requirement, and double-write risk; implementation keeps the controlled branch skip-first and uses ConnectorFrameworkService.buildContextForInstallation only after the allowlist and release gates pass. CTO-lens: connector write-path code exists but remains unreachable unless VNEXT_MUTATION_ENABLED, the exact four-field allowlist, and the approved release SHA all match; this commit does not authorize enabling those gates or performing any real Shopify mutation.
acceptance: Shopify ProductSetInput is built from ShopifyChannelProjection, not ProductPayload or the legacy buildProductSetInput mapper.

The marketplace call site checks exact tenantKey, connectorSlug, installationId, productId, and approved release SHA before building projection, resolving mapping, building connector context, or touching the Shopify connector.
When skipped, the existing connectorFramework.publish/update path remains the fallback behavior.
When executed under exact test gates, the controlled branch calls only ShopifyConnector.applyControlledMutation and uses its result instead of double-writing through the legacy publish/update path.
applyControlledMutation sends caller-supplied ProductSet input unchanged and maps Shopify user errors through the existing ShopifyPublishError issue model.
The controlled connector method does not run the legacy single-variant secondary price update and does not issue a publishablePublish call.
No environment file flips VNEXT_MUTATION_ENABLED on; no production mutation is authorized by this story.
stories.notes: Projection does not carry every legacy ProductPayload-only field. HS/taxCode harmonizedSystemCode is intentionally not invented by the adapter; future authorization artifacts must review expected diffs for the chosen product before enabling the gate. Controlled mutation currently limits blast radius to ProductSet only; publication-target writes stay out of this branch unless a later signed story explicitly adds them.
